purpose: Determine whether the replicated V2.8.6 continuous dual-compression mechanism concentrates strongly enough in its top quintile to justify a single fixed prospective Setup-shape candidate, without threshold search.

setup_shape_candidate.within_date_score_rank: average-rank percentile among valid PIT-eligible fold2 securities.

outcomes.primary_daily_metric: mean exact D+10 same-source hfq return of Q5 minus mean exact D+10 same-source hfq return of Q1
outcomes.secondary_daily_metric: Q5 minus Q1 exact D+5 spread
outcomes.supporting_metric: Q5 D+10 excess versus all valid fold2 securities on the same date

market_state.definition: Reuse frozen CSI300 rv10/rv60 CALM/STRESSED state.
market_state.role: Robustness strata only; no state superiority claim.

statistics.quarter_stability: positive all-market D10 Q5-Q1 mean spread in at least two-thirds of valid quarters and every leave-one-valid-quarter-out mean spread > 0

pass_requires_all: All-market D10 spread 95% moving-block bootstrap CI entirely above zero.
CALM mean D10 Q5-Q1 spread > 0 and its 95% CI entirely above zero.
STRESSED mean D10 Q5-Q1 spread > 0 and its 95% CI entirely above zero.
All-market mean D10 Q5 excess versus all valid fold2 securities > 0.
Q5 has the highest aggregate mean D10 return among the five score quintile bands.
Every leave-one-valid-quarter-out D10 Q5-Q1 mean spread > 0.
No source, PIT, calendar, identity or implementation blocker.

promotion_effect.PASS: Freeze Q5 as the only V2.8.8 Setup-shape candidate and validate it unchanged on untouched fold3.
promotion_effect.FAIL: Do not search alternative score percentiles on fold2.
promotion_effect.all_states: No Setup emission, Episode, First60 append or live authorization.

E_layer_boundary.note: V2.8.7 is technical Setup-shape research only. Prospective AI-Core use still requires V2.8.4 U(D) AND E(D)=ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE at signal time.

forbidden: No added trend/breakout filter on fold2.
No fold3 or fold4 price retrieval.
